note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's web-search allowance was used up before this part began, and WebFetch could not resolve most Kentucky hosts, so pages were read with the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py). The main source is the State Board of Elections' official 2022 and 2024 general election recaps, county by county; the 2022 recaps for Anderson, Bourbon, Carter, Fayette, Fleming, Garrard, Greenup, LaRue, Lee, Mercer, Pendleton, Robertson and Spencer are scans with no text, so nothing was read from them. Party labels are recorded only from those recaps, never from the Wikipedia fiscal-court list. Lee County's PVA in the Department of Revenue's directory is another person, so nothing is recorded for Leeroy Douglas Brandenburg. Jamie Lynn Lienberger was on Hopkinsville's 2022 ballot for Ward 9, but the city's council page now lists another person for Ward 9, so no office is recorded for her. Adrielle Camuel is a sitting legislator with a record page; no campaign site could be reached for her. Nothing was found that could be read for the constables, the Bourbon and Pendleton jailers, the Crittenden write-in, the Robertson magistrate, the Erlanger and Lyndon council candidates, or the Greenup and Murray school-board candidates.
verifier_note: Every url re-opened with states/net.py on 2026-10-03. Recaps are precinct by precinct, so winners and losers were checked by adding the precinct totals. Start years were corrected to what a page states: the PVA directory gives each PVA's start (Mattingly December 2022, Kiser Roseberry February 2014, Plummer December 2014); where a page shows only a 2022 election, the start year is left blank, since earlier service cannot be ruled out. Johnny Pennington's 'not elected' was dropped: the LaRue recap covers only part of the 24th District. Richmond 2022 confirmed from the Madison County 2022 recap as well (Cole third of four elected).
